metadata.description: Nonprofit, foundation, church and association back-office agents. Each reads your exported files, writes reports locally and waits for a named person before anything that moves money, sends a message, files with a government or changes a live system.

plugins.name: fairgive-acknowledgements
plugins.description: Fairgive Acknowledgements: finds gifts at or over your acknowledgement threshold with no letter, late letters, letters with a different amount or no goods-and-services statement, and letters for refunded gifts. Drafts the letters for a person to send. Never sends.

plugins.name: fairgive-board-designated
plugins.description: Fairgive Board Designated: checks board-designated funds against the board resolutions log: designations and spending with no resolution, balances below zero, designations shown as donor-restricted and designations above unrestricted net assets. Never posts.

plugins.name: fairgive-daf-grants
plugins.description: Fairgive DAF Grants: lists gifts from donor-advised fund sponsors and flags the ones to look at: DAF grants used for event benefits, applied to a personal pledge, hard-credited to the advisor or acknowledged as tax-deductible to the advisor. Not tax advice.

plugins.name: fairgive-duplicate-donors
plugins.description: Fairgive Duplicate Donors: finds likely duplicate donor records in a constituent export by e-mail, phone, address and name similarity, with the gifts on each record. Writes a merge worklist for a person. Never merges or deletes records.

plugins.name: fairgive-endowment-draw
plugins.description: Fairgive Endowment Draw: works out each endowment fund's draw from your spending policy (rate times the average of past quarter-end values), flags underwater funds, too little history and rates over the prudence presumption in your settings, and drafts the draw memo.

plugins.name: fairgive-event-revenue
plugins.description: Fairgive Event Revenue: splits event ticket and table sales into the exchange part (fair market value of the benefits) and the contribution part, and compares the split with your ledger. Lists ticket types with no fair market value. Never posts.

plugins.name: fairgive-expense-reports
plugins.description: Fairgive Expense Reports: checks staff expense report lines against your policy settings: missing receipts, meals over the per diem, mileage over the rate, alcohol and other unallowable costs charged to grants, duplicate claims and late submissions. Never pays or approves.

plugins.name: fairgive-form-990-data
plugins.description: Fairgive Form 990 Data: checks that the data behind common Form 990 schedules is complete: Schedule B contributors over the threshold with name and address, Schedule M noncash gifts, Schedule I grants with EIN, and officer hours and pay. Files nothing; not tax advice.

plugins.name: fairgive-functional-expenses
plugins.description: Fairgive Functional Expenses: builds the natural-by-function expense table (program, management and general, fundraising) from your ledger and allocation rules, and flags expenses with no function, shared costs not allocated and allocation rules that do not add to 100%.

plugins.name: fairgive-fund-balances
plugins.description: Fairgive Fund Balances: fund balances by restriction class from your fund list and ledger: restricted funds spent below zero, funds coded to the wrong net asset class, endowment corpus below the gift value and due-to/due-from that do not net to zero. Never posts entries.

plugins.name: fairgive-gift-coding
plugins.description: Fairgive Gift Coding: checks how gifts were coded: notes that name a restricted purpose on an unrestricted fund, gifts to inactive funds, appeals coded to a fund other than their default and restricted funds used for another purpose. Never changes the CRM.

plugins.name: fairgive-gift-deposits
plugins.description: Fairgive Gift Deposits: matches gifts in your donor CRM to bank deposits and to contribution revenue in the general ledger, by batch, date and amount. Lists gifts never deposited, deposits with no gifts and months where the CRM and the GL disagree. Never posts or changes anything.

plugins.name: fairgive-giving-statements
plugins.description: Fairgive Giving Statements: builds year-end contribution statements per giver from your church or nonprofit giving records, and flags givers with no address, gifts dated in another year, refunds and loose offering with no giver. Drafts the statements for a person to send.

plugins.name: fairgive-grant-budgets
plugins.description: Fairgive Grant Budgets: grant budget against actual by grant and budget line, with costs shared across several grants by allocation percentages: lines over budget beyond your flexibility rule, allocations over or under 100%, costs outside the grant period and unallowable categories. Never posts.

plugins.name: fairgive-grant-drawdowns
plugins.description: Fairgive Grant Drawdowns: for reimbursement and advance grants, allowable costs incurred against draws received: the amount you can draw, costs waiting too long, draws over costs or over the award. Drafts the drawdown request for a person. Never submits it.

plugins.name: fairgive-grant-reports
plugins.description: Fairgive Grant Reports: builds the reporting calendar for every grant from its schedule and period, and flags reports overdue, due soon, final reports after the period ends and grants with no schedule. Writes a calendar file. Never submits anything to a funder.

plugins.name: fairgive-in-kind-gifts
plugins.description: Fairgive In-Kind Gifts: checks the in-kind gift log: gifts with no value or valuation method, values taken only from the donor, items over the appraisal and Form 8283 thresholds in your settings, services that need a recognition decision, and in-kind totals missing from the ledger.

plugins.name: fairgive-indirect-costs
plugins.description: Fairgive Indirect Costs: rebuilds the indirect cost base (modified total direct costs) per grant from the ledger, leaving out equipment, participant support and subaward amounts over the cap, applies the rate in your settings and compares with the indirect charged.

plugins.name: fairgive-lapsed-donors
plugins.description: Fairgive Lapsed Donors: lists donors who gave last year but not this year (LYBUNT) and in an earlier year but not this one (SYBUNT), with retention, upgrades and downgrades by fiscal year. Reads your gift export only. Never contacts anyone.

plugins.name: fairgive-liquidity
plugins.description: Fairgive Liquidity: works out financial assets available for general spending within one year from your balance sheet accounts and restrictions, with months of operating expenses covered. Flags restricted cash counted as available and receivables due after a year.

plugins.name: fairgive-matching-gifts
plugins.description: Fairgive Matching Gifts: finds gifts from donors whose employer matches, with the match amount, the claim deadline and the claims sent or received: eligible gifts not claimed, deadlines close or passed, matches received that differ. Drafts donor reminders. Never submits a claim.

plugins.name: fairgive-memberships
plugins.description: Fairgive Memberships: checks members and dues payments: memberships expiring soon or lapsed, dues paid that do not match the level, payments that did not extend the membership, and active members with no payment. Drafts renewal notices. Never charges or sends.

plugins.name: fairgive-payroll-allocation
plugins.description: Fairgive Payroll Allocation: compares salaries charged to programs and grants with timesheets or effort reports: charges that differ from effort, effort over 100%, grant-funded staff with no effort certification and pay never allocated. Never changes payroll.

plugins.name: fairgive-pledges
plugins.description: Fairgive Pledges: ages pledges receivable from pledge and payment exports: overdue installments, overpaid and paid-off pledges still open, write-offs without an approval, and multi-year pledges with no discount. Drafts pledge reminders. Never writes off or sends.

plugins.name: fairgive-processor-fees
plugins.description: Fairgive Processor Fees: checks Stripe, PayPal, Givebutter or Classy transactions against the fee rates in your settings: fees over the rate, gifts booked net of fees, donor-covered fees, refund fees and payouts missing from the bank. Never moves money.

plugins.name: fairgive-quid-pro-quo
plugins.description: Fairgive Quid Pro Quo: finds payments over your quid pro quo threshold where the donor received goods or services and the receipt has no disclosure, no fair market value or the wrong deductible amount. Thresholds are settings. Not tax advice.

plugins.name: fairgive-recurring-gifts
plugins.description: Fairgive Recurring Gifts: checks recurring gift plans against processor charges: failed charges, plans with several failures in a row, missed months, cards about to expire and charges after a cancellation. Drafts update-your-card notes. Never charges or sends.

plugins.name: fairgive-refunds-chargebacks
plugins.description: Fairgive Refunds Chargebacks: matches processor refunds and chargebacks to CRM gifts: refunds still standing as gifts in the CRM, acknowledgements sent for refunded gifts, refunds larger than the gift and disputes with evidence due. Never refunds or responds.

plugins.name: fairgive-restriction-releases
plugins.description: Fairgive Restriction Releases: compares spending on restricted purposes and time restrictions that have ended with the releases recorded. Lists releases still to record, releases over the spending or the balance, and drafts the release entry for your accountant. Never posts it.

plugins.name: fairgive-single-audit
plugins.description: Fairgive Single Audit: totals federal award spending by assistance listing number for the fiscal year against the single audit threshold in your settings, and lists missing listing numbers and pass-through ids. Data for your auditor, not a determination.

plugins.name: fairgive-vendor-1099
plugins.description: Fairgive Vendor 1099: finds vendors paid at or over the 1099 threshold in your settings, with payments by card left out: no W-9 on file, no or malformed taxpayer id, missing address, attorneys paid as corporations. Taxpayer ids are masked. Files nothing.

plugins.name: fairgive-volunteer-hours
plugins.description: Fairgive Volunteer Hours: totals volunteer hours by program from your hours log, values them at your hourly rate setting, and flags shifts over your daily maximum, future dates, duplicate entries, missing programs, background checks due and skilled services to look at for recognition.
